CustomField.description: Used for merge field in Reg B or Notice of Incomplete Application email.
CustomField.formula: IF( Primary_Object__c = 'Lead', Lead__r.Street & BR() & Lead__r.City & ", " & Lead__r.State & " " & Lead__r.PostalCode, Contact__r.Account.BillingStreet & BR() & Contact__r.Account.BillingCity & ", " & Contact__r.Account.BillingState & " " & Contact__r.Account.BillingPostalCode )
CustomField.label: Decline Email Mailing Address Formula
